Homemade peppermint schnapps is my jam right now, it's super simple to make, takes like 20 minutes

Things you'll need:

4oz Granulated sugar
2oz Light/clear corn syrup
16oz Purified water
1/2tbs+ peppermint extract
Everclear or high alcohol content vodka, I use 10oz of 40% vodka personally.
End product: approx 30oz of 13% ABV schnapps.

Put water in saucepan at medium heat, add in the sugar and corn syrup. Stir occasionally until the sugar begins to dissolve, then add the peppermint extract. This is personal preference, I love peppermint so I use a whole tablespoon, but that might not be for you. Bring the heat up slowly until it begins to boil a bit, and after about 15 minutes on the stove, it should start taking on a slightly amber tint from the sugar beginning to caramelize. At that point, pull it off, let it cool somewhat, mix with vodka and you're done! If you're already a vodka drinker like I am, this is cheaper than buying schnapps and you get to adjust for your own taste and tolerance.

Of course, then we take the peppermint schnapps and make some spiked hot chocolate!

Things you'll need:

6oz milk+cocoa mix
1 shot Baileys
1 shot peppermint schnapps
1 candy cane

Heat milk in microwave until boiling, add cocoa and stir with candy cane until all powder breaks up. Add baileys, add schnapps, stir. Drink and then make another because fuck that shit is good.

Any good drink recipes?

Take 1 stick (half a cup) of unsalted butter and let it soften at room temperature. Add 1 cup of packed brown sugar (I prefer golden brown) 1 1/2 teaspoons of cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg and a pinch of cloves to the butter and cream the mixture thoroughly. Place the mixture onto wax paper and shape into a log. Take 1 twelfth of the log and put it in an 8 ounce mug, at 1 and 1/2 shots of dark rum and fill with boiling (the butter is going to cool the water down so you need it boiling) water. You now have hot buttered rum, you should probably sit down because life isn't go be the same after this. Merry Christmas.
